name: Prestige - City Page Slug Migration 2026-08-12
body:
> Plan · Prestige · 2026-08-12

# Summary
This plan moves the 6 city pages from `/service-areas/<city>/` to top-level `/<city>/` (Roto-Rooter style), keeping the visible breadcrumb. It deliberately uses no 301 redirects because the pages were never indexed, so the old URLs simply 404. The file is written as a DRAFT that was blocked by the NameHero disk-quota issue. The baseline audit update log records it as deployed live on 2026-08-12.

# Slug map
| Old | New |
|---|---|
| /service-areas/bluffton/ | /bluffton/ |
| /service-areas/hilton-head-island/ | /hilton-head-island/ |
| /service-areas/okatie/ | /okatie/ |
| /service-areas/sun-city/ | /sun-city/ |
| /service-areas/hardeeville/ | /hardeeville/ |
| /service-areas/ridgeland/ | /ridgeland/ |

# Method
1. Run a site-wide find and replace of the 6 path strings across every .html file. This fixes 607 references across 41 pages: nav, footer, tiles, blog links, plus each page's canonical, og:url and BreadcrumbList leaf. It is safe because every reference has a trailing slash and the bare `/service-areas/` hub path is never matched.
2. Move the 6 folders up to the web root. The `/service-areas/` hub folder stays.
3. Update the 6 sitemap.xml entries.
4. After deploy: spot-check that new URLs return 200 and old ones 404, resubmit the sitemap, request indexing on the 6 new URLs and the 2 hubs, and update any GBP, citation or social links that point at old URLs.

# What stays the same
- Visible breadcrumb: Home / Service areas / City.
- The `/service-areas/` hub stays live and lists all 6 cities.

# Status
- Deployed 2026-08-12 per [Prestige - SEO Baseline Audit 2026-08-12](lib:brain-prestige-seo-baseline-audit-2026-08-12). Indexing requests on the new URLs were still pending at that time.
